## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      6 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 23.09.2026 - 26.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _9host_girl_, 26.09.2026, 1/5: "Now I won’t have any extra money for my birthday. It could take a while for the refund request to Apple to go through, so it most likely won’t be solved in time, as my birthday is tomorrow. Very sad and deleting the app now. I was using it to help me gain weight and track my calories, since I’ve been stressed and lost weight. I’ve had this app for a long time, and used it in the past to maintain weight, but this experience has ruined it for me honestly. It’s just too high of a charge for forgetting to cancel a free trial & not worth all this extra stress"
            2. _lovelyorangelady_, 23.09.2026, 3/5: "I have been an avid user of this app for the past couple of years. I will say the interface is easy to use, but within the last few months there have been features that were originally free now hidden behind a paywall. this is absolutely ridiculous that I cannot set my own macro goals and that they HAVE to be on a set amount. I understand that some features need to be paid for, but this is just made me not want to use the app. Absolutely ridiculous."
            3. _Jelly_fishy_, 24.09.2026, 5/5: "So this app is very helpful,but I don’t like how you have to pay premium in order to track your protein consumption. I get it, This is what it takes to keep the app free,but at least let me log what I need too."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      5 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 23.07.2026 - 24.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Kaspar Lee_, 24.09.2026, 1/5: "Literally a million settings and no setting for this, always getting random notifications at random times to try and get me back on the app, zero setting to turn off. Also app is quite buggy and over complicated."
            2. _IXE_04_, 24.09.2026, 1/5: "The app used to be way better. The UI is confusing, jumbled, and overall just horrible compared to the old one not to mention it glitches and lags way more now. figure it out!"
            3. _RuachOo_, 19.09.2026, 1/5: "The app has become so bloated over the years its extremely slow, and the unnecessary praising and popups is super annoying. Less clicks = better experience. It also often just freezes for 10seconds before responding again when i open the app"
<!--/ir-theme-->
